vectors.name: dfu-request-ids
vectors.note: request ids 0, 1, 127, 128, 4095 and none; the reply carries the id, bit 6 clear

vectors.name: dfu-device-7f
vectors.note: the device byte is not checked; the reply carries 21

vectors.name: dfu-device-00
vectors.note: the device byte is not checked; the reply carries 21

vectors.name: dfu-device-21
vectors.note: the device byte is not checked; the reply carries 21

vectors.name: dfu-reply-form
vectors.note: a message in the reply form (flags bit 6 clear) of 11 bytes or more is handled; offset 9 is ignored and the payload starts at offset 10

vectors.name: dfu-9-bytes
vectors.note: a 9-byte TE message gets no reply

vectors.name: dfu-10-bytes
vectors.note: the shortest request: command, no payload

vectors.name: dfu-cmd-unknown
vectors.note: commands 00 and 04-7F: status 02, no payload

vectors.name: dfu-sub-unknown
vectors.note: status 03, no payload: an empty payload, unknown sub-commands, a begin of 17 bytes, a chunk of 1 byte

vectors.name: dfu-reboot
vectors.note: the reply comes first; the reset follows at least 10 ms later (scenario H-DFU-UPLOAD)

vectors.name: dfu-begin-long
vectors.note: bytes from 18 on are ignored; bytes 1-9 and the length are not checked

vectors.name: dfu-begin-sku-bits
vectors.note: bits 0-9 and 24-31 of the product word are not interpreted

vectors.name: dfu-begin-again-before-chunk
vectors.note: a begin while a transfer has no chunk yet changes nothing

vectors.name: dfu-begin-after-chunk
vectors.note: a begin after a chunk discards the transfer and starts a new one at 0

vectors.name: dfu-begin-bad-product-34
vectors.note: incorrect sku: and the TE code of the word

vectors.name: dfu-begin-bad-variant
vectors.note: incorrect sku: and the TE code of the word

vectors.name: dfu-begin-bad-zero
vectors.note: incorrect sku: and the TE code of the word

vectors.name: dfu-begin-bad-over-999
vectors.note: incorrect sku: and the TE code of the word

vectors.name: dfu-begin-bad-variant-f
vectors.note: incorrect sku: and the TE code of the word

vectors.name: dfu-chunk-wrap
vectors.note: 300 chunks: the numbers wrap from 255 to 0; then a repeated and a skipped number

vectors.name: dfu-chunk-empty-data
vectors.note: a chunk of 2 bytes appends nothing and is accepted

vectors.name: dfu-chunk-no-transfer
vectors.note: with no transfer in progress: status 01 and one of the two texts

vectors.name: dfu-overflow
vectors.note: a payload of 4097 bytes: buffer overflow, and the transfer ends

vectors.name: dfu-overflow-4096
vectors.note: a payload of exactly 4096 bytes is handled

vectors.name: dfu-overflow-echo
vectors.note: buffer overflow for every command, the echo and an unknown one included
